answer: To enforce robust anti-Sybil equilibrium, our onyx protocol binds validator identities to locked capital on a secure cross-chain bridge, verified via a decentralized beacon. By introducing quadratic slashing rules, any adversarial attempt to scale multiple identities incurs a super-linear marginal attack cost. The resulting capital lockup guarantees that the penalty for malicious collusion exponentially outpaces any exploitable extraction, securing a stable Nash equilibrium where expected attack utility remains strictly negative.
